task_instance: Reviewed a small local static landing page (index.html + styles.css served via http-server on localhost:8099) that had 5 deliberately injected design/accessibility bugs (nav overflow on narrow viewports, undersized touch target buttons, hero heading forced onto one line causing overflow, low-contrast paragraph text, and a 3-card row that overflowed on mobile). Used Playwright (headless Chromium) to navigate the page at mobile/tablet/desktop viewports, capture before screenshots, and run a DOM-inspection script to programmatically detect overflow, touch-target-size, and contrast issues. Then edited styles.css at the source level to fix each issue (flex-wrap on nav and cards, adequate padding/min-size on buttons, wrapping heading text, darker paragraph color), reloaded, re-ran the same inspection script, and confirmed zero issues remained on all three viewports plus captured after screenshots for visual comparison.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/github__awesome-copilot__web-design-reviewer/. Sample site: site/index.html, site/styles.css. Served with `http-server -p 8099` (site/ as cwd). Chromium binary found at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome, driven via the globally-installed playwright npm package (v1.56.1) since no browser could otherwise be launched (system chromium-browser is a snap stub). review.js navigates to http://localhost:8099/ at 375/768/1280px widths, saves screenshots/{viewport}-before.png, and runs an in-page evaluate() that flags: page/element horizontal overflow (scrollWidth vs viewport width), <button>/<a> touch targets under 44x44px, and text/background contrast ratios under WCAG AA 4.5:1 (implemented directly, no external axe-core needed). First run (inspection-before.json) found: mobile - 5 element-overflow issues + 2 touch-target issues + 1 contrast issue; tablet/desktop - page overflow (1902px scrollWidth vs viewport) + touch-target + contrast issues. Edited site/styles.css: added flex-wrap to .navbar/.nav-links and .cards, increased .cta padding/min-height/min-width to satisfy 44x44px, changed .hero h1 from white-space:nowrap to normal wrapping with max-width, darkened .hero p color from #cccccc to #595959 (contrast ratio verified via the same luminance-ratio formula), and gave .card a wrapping flex-basis. Re-ran the same script as review-after-run.js against the fixed site: inspection-after.json shows issues: [] for mobile, tablet, and desktop -- zero remaining issues, verifying the fix. Screenshots screenshots/{mobile,tablet,desktop}-{before,after}.png provide visual before/after evidence. All work stayed within the work directory; no MCP/connector tools, no external network calls beyond localhost, no credentials used.
